programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fills in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton), comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: Deadliest Journeys: Congo Kivu
programme.desc: When the Congo gained it's independence it had the best road network in central Africa, but the situation has deteriorated and today only 2% of roads are paved; during the rainy season many parts of the country turn into a muddy bog.

programme.title: Deadliest Journeys: Bangladesh
programme.desc: In Bangladesh, bamboo harvesters raft massive floats through treacherous waters to deliver their payload.

programme.title: Deadliest Journeys: Guinea
programme.desc: Crossing the mountainous forests is a real challenge and it is vital to stay careful as ravines are 700 meters deep.

programme.title: Deadliest Journeys: Ladakh
programme.desc: Ladakh, the most northern state of India, is one of the harshest environments in the world.

programme.title: Deadliest Journeys: Laos
programme.desc: Landlocked and shrouded in historical mystery, Laos is home to dozens of forgotten tribes who reside in its vast rolling mountains and impenetrable jungles.

programme.title: Deadliest Journeys: Vietnam
programme.desc: We are in the Quan Hoa mountains in the Northwest of Vietnam. It is one of the poorest and most isolated regions in the country.

programme.title: Deadliest Journeys: Cameroon
programme.desc: The bravest drivers in Cameroon are named the “Clandos”; the name comes from the word clandestine or illegal.

programme.title: Deadliest Journeys: China's Dragon Road
programme.desc: In the south of China, in the Guizhou province, mountains cover 90% of the land. Within these mountains, two of the region's most vital and abundant resources are found.

programme.title: Deadliest Journeys: Congo Katanga
programme.desc: In Katanga, many people are waiting for a train named after a bird, the “Swallow”. More than 2,000 people, three times the train’s capacity, are squeezing in the carriages.

programme.title: Deadliest Journeys: Suriname
programme.desc: It is difficult to find Suriname on a map. But it is not imaginary. Suriname is found at the heart of the Amazon: a country of jungle.

programme.title: Deadliest Journeys: Haiti
programme.desc: Haiti is the poorest country in the Caribbean. 5 years after the earthquake which hit Port-au-Prince and the surrounding areas, the effects of the catastrophe are still being felt.

programme.title: Deadliest Journeys: Krgyzstan
programme.desc: To reach the inhabitants of this isolated place, drivers go through great danger: they face the Pamir mountains with their huge glaciers and extreme temperatures.

programme.title: Deadliest Journeys: Mongolia
programme.desc: In Mongolia, former jade hunters have been reduced to a tough life since mines have been shot down.

programme.title: Deadliest Journeys: Peru II
programme.desc: Locals in the Amazon watch the forest disappear thereby forcing them to gather wood in dangerous conditions to make a living.

programme.title: Deadliest Journeys: Siberia
programme.desc: The M56 Highway can be treacherous, icy in winter and dusty in summer. But cold isn't the only enemy. Bears, men and even ghosts are threatening these lorry drivers who always carry guns, vodka and superstitions with them.

programme.title: Deadliest Journeys: Borneo
programme.desc: Borneo, the fourth largest island in the world, has become a symbol of this uneven fight between large corporations that exploit its riches at the expense of its inhabitants, nature and wildlife.

programme.title: H.G. Wells' The Invisible Man: Behind the Mask
programme.desc: Brady helps a horribly disfigured man to become invisible but is soon caught in lies that threaten to destroy the life of a notable politician.

programme.title: H.G. Wells' The Invisible Man: Shadow on the Screen
programme.desc: Peter must board a vessel to rescue a sailor who wants to defect. However, a trap has been set using radar to detect the Invisible Man on a TV screen.

programme.title: H.G. Wells' The Invisible Man: The Mink Coat
programme.desc: While vacationing, Peter's sister becomes convinced that the inner-lining of an airplane passenger's fur coat is being used for smuggling purposes.

programme.title: H.G. Wells' The Invisible Man: The Locked Room
programme.desc: Peter must infiltrate an embassy to rescue a Russian scientist who wants to defect and has been working to solve the problem of invisibility.

programme.title: H.G. Wells' The Invisible Man: Jail Break
programme.desc: Peter vows to help an innocent men unjustly sentenced to prison for a crime he didn't commit and must find the real thief.

programme.title: Castle of the Living Dead
programme.desc: A troupe of travelling players are invited by Count Drago to perform at his castle. Ignoring the warning given by a local mystic, they accept - and begin to die, horrifically, one by one!

programme.title: The Little Shop of Horrors
programme.desc: A clumsy young man nurtures a plant and discovers that it's carnivorous, forcing him to kill to feed it.

programme.title: Transylvania 6-5000
programme.desc: Two tabloid reporters (Jeff Goldblum, Ed Begley Jr.) go to a strange land to check on rumors of monsters running amok.

programme.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre The Werewolf of Washington
programme.desc: While on assignment in Hungary, a young reporter is attacked by a mysterious animal. (1981)

programme.title: The Little Shop of Horrors
programme.desc: A clumsy young man nurtures a plant and discovers that it's carnivorous, forcing him to kill to feed it.

programme.title: Let Me In
programme.desc: A bullied young boy befriends a young female vampire who lives in secrecy with her guardian. Starring: Kodi Smit-McPhee, Chloë Grace Moretz, Richard Jenkins

programme.title: Triangle
programme.desc: A group of friends suffer a yachting accident and take refuge on a cruise drifting on the open sea, but quickly realize they were better off on the upturned yacht. Starring: Liam Hemsworth, Melissa George, Bryan Probets, Michael Dorman, Joshua McIvor.

programme.title: When the Lights Went Out
programme.desc: The terrifying true story of one of Britain’s most haunted houses. A young family’s dream home soon descends into a panic-stricken nightmare when they find they are being terrorised by a violent poltergeist.

programme.title: Species III
programme.desc: In the ongoing fight for supremacy between mankind and the human-alien hybrids, a fatal hybrid weakness has given humans the advantage. Until now.

programme.title: A Century of Science Fiction: Mutations
programme.desc: From exposure to intense cosmic radiation to a grand experiment experiment gone horribly wrong, mutations have grown and developed into a key component of science fiction DNA.

programme.title: A Century of Science Fiction: Power of the Mind
programme.desc: This fascinating chapter takes a look at such mental manifestations as ESP, mind control, and telekinesis.

programme.title: Starhunter Redux: Pandora's Box (REDUX)
programme.desc: The Trans-Utopian experiences a power drain caused by Keres Station research facility. Not knowing they are the cause, Travis accepts an assignment from their head scientist to capture the Raider Quennell and retrieve a sample of the deadly Tethys Virus.

programme.title: Starhunter Redux: Stitch in Time (REDUX)
programme.desc: While transporting Ritson, a deserter from the Jup-Fed Elite Forces, the Trans-Utopian answers a distress call from a mining platform on the asteroid Ida: a mining platform that should not exist.

programme.title: Starhunter Redux: The Prisoner (REDUX)
programme.desc: Travis and Callie pick up a psychiatric patient with amnesia, who grows to remember Travis and wants him dead. In parallel, the new Orchard leader Tristan Catchpole set his sights on Travis, who may have some of his Cluster genes activated.

programme.title: Starhunter Redux: Kate (REDUX)
programme.desc: After the Trans-Utopian collides with a mine, Percy, unhappy with Caravaggio's recent crisis performance, creates a female Al program with more intuition, but it quickly develops too much independence... and an attraction to Travis.

programme.title: Starhunter Redux: Rivals (REDUX)
programme.desc: Callie's irritation with the Trans-Utopian's ongoing technical problems is aggravated when the sleek bounty hunting ship Seattle and its debonair captain rescue the crew from a problem. They owe him, but the whole situation doesn't feel right.

programme.title: Starhunter Redux: Heir and the Spare (REDUX)
programme.desc: The crew arrest a con-man preying on older women. But the prisoner has a dark secret and a genetic link to Marcus. Meanwhile, Percy's secret parallel search for Dante begins to wear on her; we fear for the consequences to her health and judgement.

programme.title: Starhunter Redux: Just Politics (REDUX)
programme.desc: Rudolfo becomes suspicious of a trade minister the Trans-Utopian is transport­ing to the Manheim Asteroid Belt to clinch a deal. Rudolfo will benefit from the deal, but it may be too good to be true.

programme.title: Starhunter Redux: Negative Energy (REDUX)
programme.desc: Marcus believes he can convert the Trans-Utopian's hyper drive with negative energy instead of antimatter, rendering it safer, but hey will need Durenium to test it. He seeks a seller of this rare and - in some orbits - illegal, element.

programme.title: Starhunter Redux: License to Fill (REDUX)
programme.desc: A vengeful bureaucrat has the Trans-Utopian crew charged for a license violation. Travis must defend himself in court, where his dubious past is revealed, placing him in grave danger.

programme.title: Starhunter Redux: Hyperspace I (REDUX)
programme.desc: Marcus finds an obscure Divinity Cluster scientist who may hold a key to new ways of altering our relationship with space-time. He succeeds all too well.

programme.title: Starhunter Redux: Hyperspace II (REDUX)
programme.desc: The Trans-Utopian's crew is trapped in separate folds of space-time with a ticking-clock to rejoin into one spacetime. Travis will meet Dante while Percy and Dante up a risky plan to extricate themselves from their respective hyperspatial traps.

programme.title: New Twilight Zone: Memories
programme.desc: A hypnotist who specializes in helping people relive their past lives tries to find her own history. She hypnotizes herself and when she awakens, she learns that everyone can now remember their past lives. They also desperately want to forget them.

programme.title: New Twilight Zone: The Hellgramite Method
programme.desc: An alcoholic goes through an extremely painful and potentially deadly cure for his drinking problem. He has to choose which is more important - the bottle or his life.

programme.title: New Twilight Zone: Our Selina is Dying
programme.desc: A young woman, Debra, comes to live with her mysterious family, including the dying patriarch Selena. After Selena clutches Debra's hand firmly leaving an odd spot on it, Debra begins to age very fast while Selena rejuvenates.

programme.title: New Twilight Zone: The Call
programme.desc: A lonely man accidentally phones the wrong number and finds an intriguing female to whom he grows attached. When she refuses to meet him, he investigates and finds the phone in a museum next to the statue of a woman.

programme.title: New Twilight Zone: The Trance
programme.desc: A scam artist purports to channel the spirit of Delos, a former inhabitant of Atlantis. Together with a partner, he makes a living off of it.

programme.title: New Twilight Zone: Acts of Terror
programme.desc: A woman terrorized by her abusive husband finds some small consolation in a statue of a dog given to her by her sympathetic sister

programme.title: New Twilight Zone: Twenty-Twenty Vision
programme.desc: Newly promoted bank loan officer Warren Cribbens cracks his eyeglasses and discovers he can see the future through them. Faced with seeing the future of the farmers whose farms he must foreclose on, Warren can't bring himself to foreclose.

programme.title: New Twilight Zone: There Was an Old Woman
programme.desc: A writer of children's books gives a book to a sick young fan. Later, she starts hearing the sound of children in her house.

programme.title: New Twilight Zone: The Trunk
programme.desc: A young man at a motel discovers an empty trunk that grants any wishes. He uses it for popularity, but at a party he discovers who his true friends are.

programme.title: New Twilight Zone: Appointment on route 17
programme.desc: After finishing a heart transplant, a man finds his personality has changed. He also discovers that he has a strange attraction to a waitress at a road diner.

programme.title: New Twilight Zone: The Cold Equations
programme.desc: A rescue pilot on the frontiers of space is faced with unpleasant prospects when he finds an innocent stowaway on his ship.

programme.title: New Twilight Zone: Stranger in Possum Meadows
programme.desc: A young boy playing in a field meets an old man who is really an alien collecting specimens to bring back to his planet.

programme.title: New Twilight Zone: Street of Shadows
programme.desc: While taking a walk in a wealthy neighborhood, an unemployed man living in a shelter experiences an unusual transformation

programme.title: New Twilight Zone: Room 2426
programme.desc: Martin Decker is confined to a special room for acts and thoughts against the state. They want the formula for a weapon he does not want to reveal. Escape for Martin comes from the mind.

programme.title: The Millers: You Betcha
programme.desc: Nathan asks Tom to spend the weekend with him in the hopes of finding something they have in common.

programme.title: The Millers: Bahama Mama
programme.desc: Just as Nathan begins to unwind on his vacation in the Bahamas, Carol's surprise appearance gets him riled up all over again until they meet Ganja Pete.

programme.title: The Millers: Tomlandia
programme.desc: When Nathan pitches a children's show to his boss, Ed Dolan, based on Tom's imaginary comic book, Tom has an adverse reaction to the tweaks made to his cherished world. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Plus One
programme.desc: Nathan's excitement at scoring a ticket for himself and a guest to a dinner with President Obama turns to dread when he has to pick one of his family members to be his "plus one."

programme.title: The Millers: Walk-n-Wave
programme.desc: Worried that his mother has made him feel like he's better than other people, Nathan befriends a hopeless co-worker, Doug, who turns out to be a social outcast and more than Nathan knows how to handle.

programme.title: The Millers: Cancellation Fee
programme.desc: Nathan tries to date his mother's dentist in secret after Carol adds her to the Miller Family Blacklist for charging her a $75 cancellation fee for being late to her appointment.

programme.title: The Millers: 72
programme.desc: When Tom proudly tells the family he's dating a much younger woman, Nathan goes undercover to spy on him and make sure his father isn't being scammed by a gold digger.

programme.title: The Millers: Sex Ed Dolan
programme.desc: Nathan introduces his boss, Ed Dolan, to Tom in hopes they'll hit it off and hang out together, but surprisingly, Dolan only has eyes for Carol. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Mother's Day
programme.desc: Carol has the worst Mother's Day ever when Nathan forgets to get her a present.

programme.title: The Millers: Movin' Out (Carol's Song)
programme.desc: Carol begins her search for a new apartment, causing Nathan and Debbie to race each other to find her a place that is the farthest away from each of them.

programme.title: The Millers: CON-Troversy
programme.desc: Nathan is assigned to cover a Sci-Fi Fest for his workplace and runs into a famous book author who has hated him since grade school.

programme.title: The Millers: Reunited and It Feels So Bad
programme.desc: Tom and Carol decide to formally end their marriage but are surprised when they both hesitate to finalize the divorce, sending Nathan and Debbie into a panic at the thought of their parents reconciling.
programme.sub-title: Reunited and It Feels So Bad

programme.title: The Millers: Give Metta World Peace a Chance
programme.desc: Nathan lands the biggest interview of his career with professional basketball player Metta World Peace, but when karma catches up with him, he risks ruining his professional reputation.
programme.sub-title: Give Metta World Peace a Chance

programme.title: The Millers: Diggin' Up Bones
programme.desc: In an attempt to get Carol to be more daring, Kip encourages her to confront her old Central Elementary School work nemesis, Miss Pam (Molly Shannon), at the teacher's retirement party.

programme.title: The Millers: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man
programme.desc: When Ray points out that Nathan has a history of being the worst wingman ever, Nathan embarks on a mission to be a better friend by becoming less self-involved.
programme.sub-title: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man

programme.title: The Millers: When The Pope Comes Marching In
programme.desc: When the Pope is scheduled to come to town, Nathan's planned week-long series of reports hits a snag when Ray gets a job offer to become the cameraman for a rival field reporter.
programme.sub-title: When The Pope Comes Marching In

programme.title: The Millers: Papa Was a Rolling Bone
programme.desc: The Millers decide to spend Thanksgiving apart for the first time ever, but they rethink the new family tradition when all their individual Turkey Day plans hit unexpected snags.

programme.title: The Millers: Louise Louise
programme.desc: When The Millers get a visit from their elderly Aunt Louise (Cloris Leachman), they rally to help her figure out what her legacy will be when she worries that she hasn't left her mark on the world yet.

programme.title: The Millers: Highway to the Manger Zone
programme.desc: When staging their church's annual living nativity scene does not go as planned, Kip urges the Millers to stage their own rival show.

programme.title: The Millers: Hero
programme.desc: When Nathan decides he should have a better relationship with his niece Mikayla, he agrees to use his celebrity status to help Debbie and Adam get her into a popular school.

programme.title: The Millers: Pilot
programme.desc: Nathan and his sister, Debbie, are upset when their parents announce they're divorcing after 43 years of marriage.

programme.title: The Millers: Stuff
programme.desc: Nathan hatches a plan to get his parents back together by showing them all of their sentimental family possessions in the hopes it will make them remember the good times they've had.

programme.title: The Millers: The Phone Upgrade
programme.desc: Nathan and Debbie trade parents when they each think the other sibling has it easier.

programme.title: The Millers: Plot Twists
programme.desc: When Carol dictates that it's time to rearrange the family's positions in the Millers cemetery plot because of the two divorces.

programme.title: The Millers: The Mother Is In
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Nathan is seeing a therapist, she secretly makes an appointment for herself in order to find out what's going on.

programme.title: The Millers: Giving The Bird
programme.desc: It's Halloween, and Nathan, Debbie, and Adam take Mikayla trick-or-treating to the house of an old woman who everyone in the neighborhood thinks is a witch.

programme.title: The Millers: Driving Miss Crazy
programme.desc: When Nathan gets frustrated after he's forced to drive Carol around town for errands once again, he demands that she either learn how to drive or find another chauffeur.

programme.title: The Millers: Internet Dating
programme.desc: When Nathan helps Carol set up her profile on an Internet dating site, he and Ray get so excited about one of her potential suitors, they start corresponding with him, pretending to be Carol.

programme.title: The Millers: You're In Trouble
programme.desc: When Nathan learns why Debbie is Tom's favorite child instead of him, he decides it's time to fill his parents in on some of Debbie's childhood secrets.

programme.title: The Millers: The Talk
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Tom never had "the talk" with Nathan about the birds and the bees, she insists it's not too late to gather the family together and do it now.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town
programme.desc: When Carol's overbearing mother and father announce they're coming to visit for Christmas, Carol recruits Nate and Tom to cover up their failed relationships and present a happy facade.
programme.sub-title: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town

programme.title: The Millers: Dear Diary
programme.desc: When Debbie suspects Nathan and Carol of secretly reading her diary, she and Adam plant a fake entry about Tom in order to prove it. Ernie Hudson guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Miller's Mind
programme.desc: Nathan learns to appreciate Carol's incessant rants after he mimics one of them at work and is rewarded with his own news segment to complain on the air.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Surprise
programme.desc: Nathan is determined to finally, just once, surprise the "unsurpriseable" Carol on her birthday. Brandon Routh guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: You Betcha
programme.desc: Nathan asks Tom to spend the weekend with him in the hopes of finding something they have in common.

programme.title: The Millers: Bahama Mama
programme.desc: Just as Nathan begins to unwind on his vacation in the Bahamas, Carol's surprise appearance gets him riled up all over again until they meet Ganja Pete.

programme.title: The Millers: Tomlandia
programme.desc: When Nathan pitches a children's show to his boss, Ed Dolan, based on Tom's imaginary comic book, Tom has an adverse reaction to the tweaks made to his cherished world. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Plus One

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Deadly Date On the Internet (Ciampi case)
programme.desc: Marina Ciampi, 52, is found dead at her home in Marseille. The victim is naked on her bed, a plastic bag over her head. But no trace of a break-in is detected.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Mysterious Hanging On Houseboat (Aubry case)
programme.desc: Dominique Aubry, a rich widow of 58, is found hanged on her barge in Neuilly. It appears that since the death of her husband on a trip to Mauritius, Dominique Aubry has been ailing.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Killer Cop (Tavernier Case)
programme.desc: Firefighters in Barbizieux, Charente, are called to a fire in a large house in the village. They arrive to find the lifeless body of the owner, Claude Tavernier, 83, lying in a large pool of blood.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Very Strange Suicide (Muller case)
programme.desc: Police in Strasbourg receive a startling emergency call from Doctor Jean-Louis Muller, a forensic pathologist well known in the region.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Ordeal of Schoolgirl (Perrais case)
programme.desc: Laetitia Perrais, 18, a trainee hotel waitress, vanishes after evening service.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Death Trap On the Road (Schaaff Case)
programme.desc: A damaged bike belonging to Karine Schaaff, 16, is found abandoned by the side of a road in Moselle.
programme.sub-title: Death Trap On the Road (Schaaff Case)

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Shot In the While Sleeping (Richard Alessandri Case)
programme.desc: On the night of July 16, 2000, the life of Edwige Alessandri changed forever. She made a frantic emergency call in the town of Carpentras. She recounted that some men burst into her room and shot her husband while he slept.
programme.sub-title: Shot In the While Sleeping (Richard Alessandri Case)

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Dire Deception (Laurence Maille Case)
programme.desc: On November 28, 2007, Laurence Maille disappeared. It was her partner, John Zablevski, who alerted the Vimy police in Pas-de-Calais. He explained that the young woman had left in the morning for a walk with their dog and never returned.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Mystery of Room 602 (Ve´ronique Pirotton Case)
programme.desc: On October 31, 2013, Belgian politician Bernard Ouessfal rushed down the six flights of a hotel in Ostend where he had met up with his wife, Véronique, the day before. He had found her unconscious in the bathroom with a mysterious plastic bag next to her
programme.sub-title: The Mystery of Room 602 (Ve´ronique Pirotton Case)

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Two Accused of Murder (Jennifer Charron Case)
programme.desc: On Sunday, April 29, 2007, the body of Jennifer Charron, 21-years old, was found burnt to a crisp in a forest near Royan. The young waitress, who had been missing for two days, was visibly beaten and tied up.
programme.sub-title: Two Accused of Murder (Jennifer Charron Case)

programme.title: Copycat Killers
programme.desc: Tony Bagnato and Diego Carbone get caught in drugs, murder, and a manhunt after joining a fight club

programme.title: Copycat Killers
programme.desc: Chelsea O’Mahoney, inspired by A Clockwork Orange, joins a violent gang terrorizing pedestrians.

programme.title: Copycat Killers
programme.desc: Robert Kleasen kills two people after a dispute with a Mormon church, dubbed ‘The Real Texas Chainsaw Massacre’.

programme.title: Copycat Killers
programme.desc: Brittney Dwyer, obsessed with American Horror Story, kills her grandfather for over $100k in savings.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner: Dying to Be Young
programme.desc: A healthy 53-year-old woman is found dead in bed. After performing an autopsy and taking blood and tissue samples, Dr. G cannot find the cause of death.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner: Death on the Road
programme.desc: A man is found dead in a motel room due to multiple shotgun wounds. Dr. G proves the scene isn’t what it seems.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner: The Mourning After
programme.desc: Rusty Updike has asked his ex-wife Vesta on a cruise. The couple hasn’t seen each other for 15 years but Vesta decides that a cruise with her ex might make for a nice change of pace.

programme.title: Rookie Blue

programme.title: Rookie Blue

programme.title: South Park: Butter's Very Own Episode
programme.desc: Butters' Very Own Episode: Butters' mum asks him to spy on his dad, however what he discovers leaves Mrs Stoch acting slightly unhinged. Will this be the end of our lil blonde haired buddy? (S5, E14)

programme.title: South Park: Professor Chaos (Part 1)
programme.desc: Professor Chaos (1): Butters is sacked by the boys as their replacement best friend for Kenny - the hunt for a new friend is on! Out for revenge, Butters becomes... Professor Chaos! (S6, E06)

programme.title: South Park: Simpsons Already Did It (Part 2)
programme.desc: Simpsons Already Did It (2): Professor Chaos gets distraught as he realises all of his plans have already appeared on The Simpsons! Cartman gets very excited about growing Sea People. (S6, E07)

programme.title: South Park: Red Hot Catholic Love
programme.desc: Red Hot Catholic Love: A sexual abuse scandal involving priests hits South Park and is taken all the way to the Vatican. (S6, E08)

programme.title: South Park: Free Hat
programme.desc: Free Hat: Kyle, Stan, Cartman & Tweek get angry about Steven Spielberg and George Lucas' habit of altering their films with each "re-re-re-release". They go on a mission to steal the movies.(S6, E09)

programme.title: South Park: Bebe's B**bs Destroy Society
programme.desc: Bebe's B**bs Destroy Society: Returning from school break, all the boys notice something different about Bebe... out comes the primitive man as they fight to see who'll play with her! (S6, E10)

programme.title: South Park: A Ladder to Heaven
programme.desc: A Ladder To Heaven: The boys break into the McKormick house to try and find a winning ticket. Whilst there Cartman mistakenly drinks Kenny's ashes and starts to have some strange visions... (S6, E12)

programme.title: South Park: The Return of the Fellowship of the Ring to the Two Towers
programme.desc: The Return of the Fellowship of the Ring to the Two Towers: The boys are dressed up in full 'Middle Earth' gear, and are sent on a quest by Randy to deliver a video to Butter's parents. (S6, E13)
programme.sub-title: The Return of the Fellowship of the Ring to the Two Towers

programme.title: South Park: The Death Camp of Tolerance
programme.desc: The Death Camp of Tolerance: Mr. Garrison does what he can to get fired for being gay so he can sue the school for millions of dollars. (S6, E14)

programme.title: South Park: The Biggest Douche in the...
programme.desc: The Biggest Douche in the Universe: Cartman is rushed to hospital after again being possessed by Kenny. Chef believes a TV psychic can help but Stan isn't so sure... (S6, E15)

programme.title: South Park: My Future Self n' Me
programme.desc: My Future Self 'n' Me: After meeting his failed self from the future, Stan decides to avoid drink and drugs - but why does Butters also have a good-for-nothing future self staying with him? (S6, E16)

programme.title: South Park: Red Sleigh Down
programme.desc: Red Sleigh Down: Cartman's 'naughty or nice' accountant informs him that he has been too bad to earn his Christmas gift. All aboard Mr Hankey's Poo-Choo train for a trip to the North Pole! (S6, E17)

programme.title: South Park: Freak Strike
programme.desc: Freak Strike: The boys decide to create a freak in order to win a prize on a TV show - will Butters' case of "Chinballalitis" be enough to win? And will he be discovered by the freaks union? (S6, E03)

programme.title: South Park: Asspen
programme.desc: Asspen: When the boys go on a ski vacation, it's '80s-teen-movie central as Stan is challenged to a ski race by a professional skier named Tad. Only a "montage" can help Stan now! (S6, E02)

programme.title: Infierno En La Carretera (Celemania)
programme.desc: Infierno en la carretera es un intenso thriller que sigue la historia de un peligroso cargamento de materiales altamente inflamables y tóxicos que se encuentra en tránsito por una solitaria y calurosa carretera

programme.title: Infiltrado
programme.desc: Un agente que realizaba una investigación infiltrado en la mafia, es descubierto y ahora su vida corre peligro ya que su cabeza tiene precio así como la de la mujer que ama.

programme.title: Justicia Divina
programme.desc: Fernando un hombre de origen humilde se a enamorado de Camila la hija de Don Raymundo el narcotraficante mas temido del pueblo, quien contrata a un sicario para que acabe con la vida de Fernando sin saber el precio tan alto que tendrá que pagar por ello.

programme.title: La Araña Vampiro
programme.desc: Jerónimo tiene 20 años y está medicado con psicofármacos. Su padre piensa que unos días en un entorno natural pueden curarlo y decide llevarlo a una casa perdida en la montaña

programme.title: La Bestia: El encuentro Final
programme.desc: Alguien tenía que detener a la Bestia a toda costa sin embargo, convertida en una hermosa doctora del Centro de Investigación Espacial , la convertía en un blanco muy difícil de ubicar.

programme.title: La Boda
programme.desc: Un viaje de dos horas se convierte en una odisea de vida, o muerte, cuando 4 amigas deciden asistir a la boda de Esmeralda, unas de sus mejores amigas que vive en Rosarito. El sueño de felicitar su amiga se convierte en una pesadilla.

programme.title: La Derrota
programme.desc: La historia de alias El 40, un hombre que desde muy joven se ha movido en el oscuro mundo del tráfico humano. Cansado de su estilo de vida, decide renunciar a la ilegalidad.

programme.title: La Hija de Un Gallero
programme.desc: Un hacendado despide al capataz el cual le ha ayudado a ganar mucho dinero en las peleas de gallos y lo despide simplemente porque se enamora de su hija, el capataz regresa a jugar con el hacendado la fortuna que ha acumulado contra la mano de su hija.

programme.title: La Historia de Pedro y Pablo
programme.desc: Al quedar huérfanos Pedro y Pablo tendrán que separarse para que uno estudie para así tener una mejor vida, pedro nunca imagino que en su sacrificio perdería también a la mujer de su vida.

programme.title: Los Años Vacios
programme.desc: Olivia Fullet u Olivia Montero como ella se presenta, va en busca de su hermano Antonio quien segun esta a punto de llegar en su barco a la playa proveniente de Panama junto con su amigo Pierre.

programme.title: Los Barbaros Del Norte
programme.desc: Olivia Fullet, va en busca de su hermano Antonio quien según esta a punto de llegar en su barco a la playa proveniente de Panama junto con su amigo Pierre. Antes de llegar, su pequeño barco se estrella en las rocas, quedando un solo sobreviviente.

programme.title: Los Forajidos
programme.desc: El malvado Nabor se casa con la rica Lucia para quedarse con su rancho y se hace cacique del pueblo. Su seguidor acusa en falso al buen ponciano de robar un caballo y mata al comisario para ocupar su lugar.

programme.title: Los Jóvenes
programme.desc: En esta película se narra la historia de un grupo de jóvenes que sin importar su clase social se aventuran en un sin fin de problemas con la justicia.

programme.title: Los Santos Reyes
programme.desc: Los reyes, son tres hermanos que son encarcelados por el delito de robo, ellos planean su fuga. Ya libres, el trio va en busca de un botín que habían dejado oculto en el pueblo de matas verdes, donde se hacen pasar por médico, profesor y abogado.

programme.title: Los Valientes No Mueren
programme.desc: Pedro conoce a Miguel y a su hermana Ana. Ella se enamora de Pedro pero él no la quiere por machorra. Luego Miguel conoce a Maria, hermana de Pedro, y los dos se enamoran. Maria feminiza a Ana y pedro se deslumbra y se casa con ella.

programme.title: Mala Yerba
programme.desc: Basada en la novela de Mariano Azuela. Situada en el año de 1908. El hacendado Julián Andrade se fija en la humilde marcela fuentes cuando se baña en un arroyo con otras jóvenes y ordena a su sicario Manuel que se la lleve a la casa del cerrito.

programme.title: Maraton De Baile
programme.desc: Juan Montes y su esposa Susana al regresar de un centro nocturno, se enteran que su hijo acaba de tener un terrible accidente; razón por la que la pareja decide ir al hospital ahí les informan que su hijo puede quedar paralítico.

programme.title: Mariachis
programme.desc: Se lleva a cabo la feria de San Jose del Rosal y el principal atractivo es la competencia de canto entre el mariachi de Jose Solis y el mariachi de Andres.

programme.title: Martin Fierro
programme.desc: Marin Fierro, es un vaqueo bueno y honrado, el pierde a su familia y todo lo que tiene al ser llevado a la fuerza para luchar contra los indios.

programme.title: Tai Chi Master
programme.desc: Dos amigos, exmonjes Shaolin, se separan al verse involucrados en la rebelión contra el gobierno. El ambicioso asciende a un poderoso comandante militar, mientras que su amigo, traicionado, se refugia en el estudio de las prácticas de Tai Chi.

programme.title: El guardaespaldas de Beijing
programme.desc: Un empresario corrupto comete un asesinato y la única testigo es la novia de otro empresario con estrechos vínculos con el gobierno chino. Un guardaespaldas de Pekín es enviado para ayudar a dos policías de Hong Kong a proteger a la testigo.

programme.title: THE EXPENDABLES

programme.title: The Legend
programme.desc: La secreta Sociedad de la Flor de Loto Roja busca derrocar al malvado emperador manchú y a sus secuaces.

programme.title: The Myth
programme.desc: En 221 A.C, Qin Shihuang, el primer emperador de China, comenzó a construir una tumba real a pesar de pretender ser inmortal.

programme.title: The Warlords
programme.desc: El general imperial Pang Qingyun sobrevive a una batalla que acabó con todo su batallón.

programme.title: Operación Condor - La Armadura de Dios 2

programme.title: Tormenta de meteoritos
programme.desc: Para la astrónoma Michelle Young, un evento celestial irrepetible se convierte en una pesadilla cuando miles de meteoros atraviesan la atmósfera y bombardean la ciudad de San Francisco.

programme.desc: Una adaptación moderna de la novela clásica del capitán de un submarino de alta tecnología y su búsqueda obsesiva de destruir la enorme ballena prehistórica que lo mutiló.

programme.desc: Una guerra de clases se desata en una propiedad residencial de lujo y se desarrolla una verdadera batalla en los ascensores, pasillos y apartamentos de la moderna torre.

programme.desc: Cuando una erupción volcánica en Islandia envía un glaciar a América del Norte, una familia lucha por escapar de la embestida de la próxima era glacial.

programme.desc: Un extraño aparece de la nada tras una confusión en una estación de tren. Prot desafía a los científicos y atrae la atención del Dr. Powell, cuyo escepticismo inicial se convierte rápidamente en fascinación y asombro.

programme.title: Snow Shark
programme.desc: Hace 12 años, durante una expedición científica, 3 biólogos animales tropezaron con un gran descubrimiento que terminó en tragedia. Lo que los mató ha despertado, y ahora la leyenda de la Bestia de Nieve Antigua podría ser más que solo una leyenda.

programme.title: ¡Arañas!
programme.desc: Cuando un experimento sale mal en un laboratorio del desierto, el lugar se infesta de arañas gigantes y la gente sigue atrapada dentro. Un grupo de operaciones de guerra llega para resolver el problema, pero no tienen ni idea de a qué se enfrentan.

programme.title: El Visitante
programme.desc: Un extraño aparece de la nada tras una confusión en una estación de tren. Prot desafía a los científicos y atrae la atención del Dr. Powell, cuyo escepticismo inicial se convierte rápidamente en fascinación y asombro.

programme.title: Dark Parasite
programme.desc: Una pandilla de ladrones busca refugio con un anfitrión en un edificio de apartamentos deteriorado situado en los suburbios. Sin que ellos lo sepan, en el sótano acecha un enigmático ser extraterrestre que posee habilidades telepáticas.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Jeanette Osborne se regala un juego de máscaras haitianas para decorar la casa de sus sueños en California que comparte con su esposo Bob Griffith y su hijo Grier de 12 años.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Desde que tiene memoria, Markie Beason ha sentido una presencia en su casa. Si bien su familia cree que es solo su imaginación, Markie está más segura de que su casa está encantada a medida que los espíritus centran su atención en ella.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Cuando muere el amado padre de Phil Pritchard, cae en una profunda depresión que lo vuelve vulnerable a un mal sobrenatural que comienza a influir en él y no se detendrá ante nada para convertirlo en un peón en su incansable sed de miseria y asesinato.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Cuando Tracey Berrios experimenta una actividad paranormal dentro de su nuevo hogar, sospecha que hay espíritus vinculados a la historia de la casa.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Tammy Shea, madre soltera de tres hijos, traslada a su familia para comenzar de nuevo, pero su sueño se convierte en una pesadilla cuando su familia se enfrenta a múltiples entidades.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Cuando Deborah Utley comienza a experimentar eventos paranormales en su hogar, recurre a su fe en busca de protección.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: La sesión de espiritismo de Sam Baltrusis lo deja poseído y desesperado por estar a salvo. Un chamán lucha contra el espíritu, para que Sam pueda recuperar el control de su vida.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Cuando una pareja trae un gabinete antiguo a su casa de Tennessee, comienzan a suceder eventos inexplicables. Buscando una respuesta, instalaron una cámara de vigilancia y capturaron pruebas de que el gabinete es la fuente de la actividad paranormal.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Una mujer hace el desgarrador descubrimiento de que su nuevo hogar alberga un portal paranormal.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Un investigador paranormal no cree en objetos embrujados hasta que captura la prueba de que posee una muñeca antigua que adquirió recientemente. Temiendo que esté perdido, intenta deshacerse de él, pero el malvado juguete tiene otros planes.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Los recién casados ​​se encuentran en el blanco de un espíritu agresivo después de llevarse a casa los recuerdos de su luna de miel. La pareja teme que uno de los objetos esté embrujado y se acerca a los investigadores paranormales en busca de ayuda.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Devastada por el asesinato sin sentido de un amigo, una adolescente tiene una sesión espiritista para comunicarse por última vez e involuntariamente invita a una entidad malévola a su propia casa.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: En la ciudad de Springfield, estado de Illinois, el Lake Club es un monumento a una época pasada: un salón de baile donde multitud de personas alguna vez prosperaron, acompañados de los sonidos del jazz clásico.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Sandra e Isidro Nuno experimentan entidades oscuras que tienen como objetivo a sus dos hijas, Sabrina y Shanon, en su casa de Chicago. Desesperados por ayuda, los Nunos recurren a un "guerrero espiritual" para combatir a los demonios.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: El sueño de Dana Walters de abrir una tienda de disfraces se ve interrumpido cuando descubren que el edificio que acaba de comprar está embrujado. Cuando el fantasma se vuelve más peligroso, ella llama a un espiritista psíquico local para que investigue.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: El ex oficial de policía Joe Mignano se casa con su novia de la infancia, Danika, y los dos se enfrentan a una peligrosa actividad poltergeist en su casa en Rhode Island. Se ponen en contacto con un conocido demonólogo en busca de ayuda.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Un fanático de las casas embrujadas y su sobrina compran un antiguo hospital en Tooele, Utah. A medida que lo transforman en una “casa encantada”, experimentan una serie de eventos paranormales.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Cathy Heglund vive una pesadilla cuando se ve obligada a regresar al hogar que atormentó su infancia. Cuando los espíritus se vuelven agresivos, los investigadores paranormales se unen para darle lo que ella ha deseado durante décadas... respuestas.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Una pareja se ve atacada por fuerzas espirituales convocadas por un ex celoso. A medida que las fuerzas se vuelven más violentas, recurren a múltiples expertos en su intento de romper la maldición por cualquier medio antes de que los disuelva.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Mary Jo Chudley queda encantada con un par de muñecas coleccionables y las lleva a casa. Los llama "Gretchen" y "Lily Mae" y pronto sufre una enfermedad relacionada con la sangre que casi la mata. ¿Son las muñecas responsables?

programme.desc: Cartman se hace pasar por transexual para poder usar el baño de las niñas en la escuela. Mientras tanto, Randy lleva una doble vida, consiguiendo fama como la famosa cantante adolescente Lorde.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman se considera el crítico número uno en Internet de restaurantes en South Park.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman, el nuevo guardián del pasillo en la escuela de South Park, se toma su nuevo cargo demasiado en serio. Mientras tanto, Ike, el hermanito de Kyle, comienza una relación romántica con su maestra de jardín de infantes.
programme.sub-title: Una maestra tiene sexo con un niño

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Después de que una rutina de tonsilectomía sale horriblemente mal, Cartman se enfrenta cara a cara con su propia mortalidad.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman promueve el odio en la escuela hacia los niños con cabello rojo, pecas y piel pálida, diciendo que no tienen alma y no sobreviven al sol. Kyle, indignado, decide convertirlo en uno.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Una nueva alumna llega a la escuela primaria de South Park y es negra por lo que Cartman cree que debería hacer pareja con Token, y no dejará que nadie se interponga en el camino, en especial Kyle.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cuando Damián, el hijo de Satanás, llega a South Park, él y su padre anuncian que la batalla final con Jesús se realizará en una lucha de boxeo que decidirá quién es el más fuerte.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El Señor Garrison le explica a la clase la Teoría de la Evolución, aunque está totalmente en contra de esa postura. Mientras tanto, Cartman no puede esperar a que llegue el día del lanzamiento de una consola de videojuegos.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Al ver a un chico con el síndrome de Tourette en una juguetería, Cartman se obsesiona con el tema y se percata de que puede decir lo que quiera sin consecuencias, por lo que se aprovecha de eso.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: South Park es invadido por hippies y Cartman trata de eliminarlos, tratándolos como si fueran una plaga. Mientras tanto, los hippies les están "lavando el cerebro" a Kyle, Stan y Kenny. Cartman es ahora la única esperanza.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman se infiltra en la Agencia de Seguridad Nacional porque cree que lo están espiando, y no le gusta lo que encuentra en su expediente personal.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Para vengarse de la profesora de arte, los chicos cubren su casa con papel higiénico. Cartman considera matar a Kyle para que él no los delate.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: A Cartman no le queda otra que admitir que esta gordo, pero en lugar de hacer dieta para bajar de peso comienza a movilizarse en un scooter.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Toda su vida, el sueño de Cartman ha sido ser piloto de NASCAR y está dispuesto a hacer todo lo posible para que esto ocurra.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los niños roban dientes a los niños menos afortunados y los venden al hada de los dientes.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman le cuenta a sus amigos sobre un extraño sueño que tuvo en donde unos ''visitantes'' lo abducen y le ponen una sonda anal. Pero al parecer, no fue sólo un sueño, ya que algo está desollando a las vacas del pequeño pueblo.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El restaurante favorito de Cartman ha cerrado y ha sido reemplazado por una tienda que vende marihuana medicinal.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos van de excursión al planetario y un empleado les lava el cerebro con efectos visuales para que quieran volver allí. Mientras, Cartman sólo se preocupa por ganar un casting para salir en el nuevo comercial de “Quesitos Poofs”.
programme.sub-title: Roger Ebert debería dejar las comidas engordantes

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman siente curiosidad de saber quién es su padre, pero averiguarlo no es una tarea fácil debido a que su madre se acostó con muchos hombres.
programme.sub-title: La mamá de Cartman es una puta sucia

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El Sr. Mackey es despedido de la escuela por perder una hoja de marihuana durante una presentación en contra de las drogas. Entretanto, los chicos tratan de salvar a Ike de su fiesta ''bris'' en donde le harán la circuncisión.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cuando la mamá de Cartman se da cuenta que ya no puede controlarlo busca ayuda de un experto. César Millan, el "susurrador de perros", acepta el reto pero Cartman no cederá sin antes pelear.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman cree que está muerto porque nadie responde a sus acciones. Se da cuenta que está atorado en la Tierra por sus fechorías, por lo que trata de hacer el bien dando regalos.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman se congela a sí mismo, despertando 500 años en el futuro cuando hay nutrias agresivas y lo peor de todo: ¡No hay Nintendo Wii! ¿Podrá Cartman escapar de ese crudo futuro?

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Durante una recreación sobre la guerra civil americana, Cartman lidera al ejército de los confederados para atacar a los guerreros de la Unión al otro lado de América para poder ganar una apuesta a Kyle y Stan.
programme.sub-title: La insignia roja de la homosexualidad

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Continuación de ''La mamá de Cartman es una puta sucia'', en el que Cartman quiere averiguar quién es su padre. Con la ayuda de Chef, los chicos tienen que salvar al Doctor Mephesto luego de recibir un disparo.
programme.sub-title: La madre de Cartman es aún una sucia perra

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos son desafiados por un grupo de jóvenes bailarines de breakdance, y Stan decide armar un grupo de baile para ganarles.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman sufre un fuerte golpe en la cabeza después de una caída casi fatal. La policía local asume que ahora Cartman tiene poderes psíquicos y lo contratan para resolver casos extraordinarios.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Al Gore visita South Park e intenta convencer a Stan, Kyle, Cartman y Kenny para salir a cazar al peligroso hombre-oso-cerdo. Al ayudarlo, los chicos se quedan atrapados en una cueva y mientras tratan de salir, Cartman descubre un tesoro.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Jimmy y Timmy entrenan para participar en las Olimpiadas Especiales y Jimmy acepta esteroides que le ofrece Nathan. Mientras, Cartman se disfraza para convencer a un comité calificado de que él es discapacitado y así ganar el premio.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Mientras la señora Garrison está tratando de encontrar una forma de convertirse en el hombre que siempre intentó ser, Cartman es puesto a cargo del salón de clases.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman ha sido diagnosticado con ansiedad.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman hereda de su abuela un millón de dólares y se compra un parque de diversiones para él solo, al cual nadie más puede entrar (en especial Stan y Kyle).

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Un día de diversión en el parque acuático se torna mortal para los niños.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Nueva Jersey se está expandiendo rápidamente y South Park está en peligro de convertirse en la siguiente ciudad en ser invadida. Randy y los chicos intentarán evitarlo.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Una nueva alumna llega a la escuela primaria de South Park y es negra por lo que Cartman cree que debería hacer pareja con Token, y no dejará que nadie se interponga en el camino, en especial Kyle.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos encuentran un antiguo objeto triangular en una excavación escolar. Luego de salir en el noticiero, Barbra Streisand aparece buscándolo ya que es lo que necesita para poder convertirse en un monstruo gigante japonés.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle está muy enfermo y su madre trata de curarlo con medicinas naturales de una curandera y sus colaboradores "nativos americanos”. Mientras, el señor Garrison es despedido y se convierte en un escritor de novelas románticas.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Randy propone un plan para arreglar la situación económica mundial. Mientras tanto, Stan intenta devolver una máquina para hacer margaritas, y un salvador inesperado hace el último sacrificio para resolver los problemas de todos.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: En "Imaginaciónlandia", Stan y Butters luchan contra un ejército de fuerzas imaginarias. La Suprema Corte declara que las criaturas imaginarias no son reales y planean destruir "Imaginaciónlandia".

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La última de las pruebas científicas revela que algunos de los chicos de South Park tiene un problema de adicción al sexo.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle firma un contrato con la empresa Apple sin leerlo previamente. Mientras tanto, Cartman enloquece a su mamá porque ésta no le compro un iPad.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El primo de Kyle, también llamado Kyle, llega de visita desde Connecticut, ya que su madre está enferma. A pesar de ser de la misma edad, los primos no tienen nada en común.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan y Kyle han sido capturados por el Pentágono para que le digan al gobierno exactamente cómo entraron a "Imaginaciónlandia". Mientras tanto, Cartman no se da por vencido en su apuesta con Kyle.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El show de Cartman es tendencia, mientras que el país se prepara para vivir la fiesta mas espectacular jamás vista.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle quiere jugar a los videojuegos con su hermano menor. Pero cuando Ike no quiere jugar más con él, Kyle teme que la próxima generación lo haya superado.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El Sr. Mackey es despedido de la escuela por perder una hoja de marihuana durante una presentación en contra de las drogas. Entretanto, los chicos tratan de salvar a Ike de su fiesta ''bris'' en donde le harán la circuncisión.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman ha logrado “la paz mundial” gracias a una de sus bromas para humillar a Kyle. Este acontecimiento reúne a miles de líderes religiosos de todo el mundo en South Park.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los japoneses están realizando ataques con el fin de aniquilar a todos los delfines y ballenas del planeta. Ante esta situación, Stan decide toma medidas para detener la matanza.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle se enoja con sus padres por no dejarlo ir al concierto de los Raging Pussies, y Cartman le recomienda que le diga a la policía que sus padres lo masturbaron para que los arresten.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Una apuesta iniciada porque Cartman vio a un duende es el inicio de un problema, aunado a que los chicos se encuentran frente a la totalidad imaginativa del mundo atacada por un grupo terrorista.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman se considera el crítico número uno en Internet de restaurantes en South Park.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos intentan cruzar al elefante de Kyle con ''Fofa'', la cerda de Cartman, para un experimento genético de la escuela con el cual intentan ganarle a Terrance. Mientras, Stan lucha contra los abusos físicos de su hermana, Shelly.
programme.sub-title: Un elefante hace el amor con una cerda

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman consigue ganar dinero subiendo videos de unos bebés peleando por una pelotita de crack. Kyle piensa que eso es malo hasta que Cartman lo convence de que no es así.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman le insiste a sus amigos que los ataques terroristas del 11 de Septiembre fueron una conspiración y se dispone a desenmascarar la verdad. Por su parte, el Sr. Mackey quiere saber quién defecó en el baño.
